positioning.your_philosophy:
The philosophy of Silicon and Stone is built on Digital Realism. It is a mindset that rejects both the blind "techno-optimism" of Silicon Valley and the paralyzing "regulatory pessimism" often found in Brussels.

Instead, it advocates for a grounded, long-term view of technology—one that understands that while code moves at the speed of light, human values, laws, and the physical earth are as unmoving as stone.
positioning.your_methodology:
The methodology of Silicon and Stone is built on Forensic Technopolitics. We don't just review technology; we perform an autopsy on the systems of power that technology enables. By combining 30 years of industrial experience with rigorous geopolitical forecasting, we apply four distinct analytical frameworks to every topic we cover.

1. Supply Chain Forensics
We treat the global semiconductor and AI infrastructure not as a market, but as a biological system with critical chokepoints.

The Process: We trace the journey of a single component—from a neon gas supplier in Ukraine to a lithography machine in the Netherlands and a foundry in Taiwan.

The Goal: To identify the Day Zero failure points for European industry before they appear on a news ticker.

2. Comparative Policy Stress-Testing
We analyze the Atlantic Drift by systematically contrasting US and EU developments.

The Process: We take a single technological advancement (e.g., Agentic AI) and run it through two operating systems: the US Innovation-First model and the EU Rights-Driven model.

The Goal: To predict where regulation will stifle growth and where innovation will violate sovereignty, providing a roadmap for transatlantic compliance.

3. Scenario-Based Drift Modeling
We use Value at Stake methodology to quantify the impact of geopolitical shifts.

The Process: We build three-tier scenarios (Low/Medium/High friction) for specific 2026 events, such as the full enforcement of the AI Act or a shift in the Donroe Doctrine.

The Goal: To move from narrative to metrics, showing exactly how many billions of Euros are at risk for specific industrial sectors like Automotive or Aerospace.

4. Experience-Led Signal Filtering
This is our Long-Memory filter. We apply a 30-year historical lens to modern hype.

The Process: We compare 2026 AI trends to the Dot-com boom, the Mobile shift, and the Cloud expansion.

The Goal: To separate the Silicon Hype (temporary noise) from the Stone Truth (structural change). If we've seen a pattern fail three times in 30 years, we tell you why the fourth time is no different.

content_focus.main_topics:
1. The Silicon: High-Velocity Disruption
These topics cover the Engine of the 2026 economy—the technologies that are moving faster than our ability to govern them.

Agentic AI & The Autonomous Workforce: Moving beyond chatbots into agents that execute multi-step workflows, manage budgets, and make autonomous decisions.

The 2nm Race: Monitoring the bleeding edge of semiconductor fabrication and the transition to next-generation lithography.

Edge Intelligence: How processing power is moving out of the centralized US cloud and onto the Stone of local devices and European soil.

Hyper-Deflationary Intelligence: Analyzing the collapsing cost of tokens and what happens to business models when intelligence becomes a commodity.

2. The Stone: Foundational Realities
These topics cover the Anchor—the geopolitical and regulatory frameworks that determine whether technology succeeds or fails in the European theater.

The Donroe Doctrine & The Atlantic Drift: Analyzing the US pivot to Western Hemisphere First and the resulting security vacuum in European tech supply chains.

The Taiwan Choke Point: Forensic tracking of the semiconductor supply chain and the 2026 Vulnerability Gap facing the German and French industrial heartlands.

The EU AI Act & Regulatory Sovereignty: Navigating the August 2026 enforcement cliff and the rise of High-Risk compliance as a competitive advantage.

Energy & Resource Sovereignty: Why Scotland's green grid and Europe's critical mineral strategy are the literal bedrock of the AI revolution.
